items.question: Is B1.church really 100% free?
items.answer: Yes. Hosted B1 is $0 forever. No tiers, no per-person cap. Live Church Solutions is a 501(c)(3) (EIN 45-5349618). Public 990. You pay Stripe or PayPal on gifts. B1 adds $0.

items.question: What features does B1.church include?
items.answer: People, giving, check-in, website builder, member app, groups, attendance, service planning, and a song library.

items.question: How does B1.church compare to Planning Center?
items.answer: Planning Center People is free. Other PCO products have free tiers, then you pay as you grow. Church Center essentials are free. B1 is the whole stack at $0 with no module step-up.

items.question: How does B1.church compare to Pushpay?
items.answer: Pushpay is a paid giving platform. B1 includes giving with no platform fee, plus the rest of the ChMS, at $0. You still pay card or ACH rates.

items.question: How does B1.church compare to Tithe.ly?
items.answer: Tithe.ly is a giving company with a paid ChMS. B1 is the ChMS, 100% free including hosting. Giving is included. Stripe nonprofit is 2.2% + $0.30; Tithe.ly "free" giving is 2.9% + $0.30.

items.question: How does B1.church compare to Breeze ChMS?
items.answer: Breeze is a paid, simple ChMS. B1 is $0 and includes the website, giving with no platform fee, check-in, and worship planning. We import Breeze people.

items.question: Does my church get a mobile app?
items.answer: Members install the app from your church site. Add to Home Screen.

items.question: Does B1.church support online giving?
items.answer: Yes. Stripe or PayPal. Recurring gifts, funds, statements. B1 adds $0.

items.question: Can I build a website with B1.church?
items.answer: Yes, B1.church includes a drag-and-drop website builder with mobile-responsive templates. You can use a custom domain, and the website integrates with all your B1 features like events, groups, and giving.

items.question: Does B1.church have check-in for children's ministry?
items.answer: Yes. Name tags, security codes, attendance.

items.question: Is B1.church open source?
items.answer: Yes, B1.church is fully open source. You can view our code on GitHub at github.com/ChurchApps. This means you can self-host if desired, contribute improvements, and trust that your data is handled transparently.

items.question: Who builds B1.church?
items.answer: B1.church is built by Live Church Solutions, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization (EIN 45-5349618). We're a ministry of developers who believe churches shouldn't have to choose between technology and ministry funding.

items.question: What other free products does Live Church Solutions offer?
items.answer: In addition to B1.church, we offer FreeShow (free presentation software at freeshow.app, an alternative to ProPresenter) and Lessons.church (free church curriculum with over 1,100 lessons for all ages). All our products are free and open source.

items.question: How do I get started with B1.church?
items.answer: Getting started is easy: visit b1.church, click 'Get Started Free', create your church account, customize your app and website, and invite your congregation. There's no credit card required and no trial period - it's free forever.

items.question: Does B1.church support multiple campuses?
items.answer: Yes, B1.church supports multi-campus churches. You can manage multiple locations from one unified dashboard with campus-specific data, attendance, and groups while maintaining a single member database.

Families look themselves up by the last 4 digits of a phone number or by name
Each person is placed in the right room, with age and grade guidance
Kiosk colors and an idle-screen slideshow match your church

sections.title: Name tags and pickup codes
sections.body: Print a name label for each child and a pickup slip for the parent with the same 4-character security code.
bullets: Brother QL label printers (QL-1110NWB recommended) with DK-1201 labels
Design your own labels
Reprint a label anytime

sections.title: Child safety built in
sections.body: Checkout and room tools that help volunteers keep kids safe.
bullets: Check out by security code, scanned by camera or barcode scanner
Authorized and not-authorized pickup lists
Room capacity and volunteer ratios that warn or block
Page a parent or send an emergency text (requires a texting provider)

sections.title: Guests welcome
sections.body: First-time families can register at the kiosk or on their own phone.
bullets: QR code guest registration with the fields you choose
Auto-add guests to a group for follow-up

sections.title: Check in before you arrive
sections.body: Members can check in their whole household from the church app.

sections.title: Attendance that records itself
sections.body: Every check-in feeds your attendance reports in B1Admin.
bullets: Weekly summary, attendance trend, and per-group attendance
Check-in windows for each service time
Headcount-only entry for services without check-in

faq.q: What hardware do we need?
faq.a: A tablet for each kiosk and, if you want name tags, a Brother QL label printer. Recommended tablets include the Samsung Galaxy Tab A-series and Amazon Fire HD 10.

faq.q: Is the check-in software free?
faq.a: Yes. Check-in is part of B1, which is free including hosting. You only buy the hardware.

faq.q: How do parents pick up their kids?
faq.a: Each child's name tag and the parent's pickup slip share a 4-character code. Volunteers check the code, or scan it, at pickup.

faq.q: Can visitors check in?
faq.a: Yes. Guests can be added at the kiosk, or scan a QR code to register on their own phone.

meta.title: About B1: Free Church Software from a Nonprofit | B1.church
meta.description: B1 is free, open-source church management software built by Live Church Solutions, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. How it's free, who funds it, and what you can expect.

hero.title: Free church software, built by a nonprofit
hero.subtitle: B1 is built by Live Church Solutions, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit ministry (EIN 45-5349618). We believe every church deserves modern technology, whatever its budget.

sections.title: How is B1 free?
sections.body: B1 is a ministry, not a business. Development and hosting are funded by donations and supported by Google Ad Grants, so churches never pay for the software.
bullets: No paid tiers, no per-member pricing, no feature limits
Hosting is included
No platform fee on gifts

sections.title: What you might still pay for
sections.body: We want you to know the full picture up front.
bullets: Card and bank processing fees, paid to your own payment processor
Tablets and label printers if you use kiosk check-in
A texting provider if you want SMS messages
Your domain name, if you use a custom one
Extra file storage beyond 100 MB, which you can also cover by linking Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, or S3

sections.title: Open source
sections.body: All of B1's code is public on GitHub across about 20 repositories.
bullets: Anyone can review how it works
Self-host with Docker or a one-click Railway template if you prefer

sections.title: Your data stays yours
sections.body: There is no lock-in.
bullets: Import from Planning Center, Breeze, Tithe.ly, Pushpay (CCB), or any CSV or Excel file with B1 Transfer
Export a full backup of people, groups, giving, attendance, and forms
Convert your data to Breeze or Planning Center formats

sections.title: One family of free tools
sections.body: B1 is part of ChurchApps, alongside FreeShow presentation software and Lessons.church curriculum. One free account works across all of them.

faq.q: Is B1 really free?
faq.a: Yes. The software and hosting are free, with no tiers and no platform fee on gifts. You pay only outside costs such as card processing fees to your own processor, and hardware if you use check-in kiosks.

faq.q: Who is behind B1?
faq.a: Live Church Solutions, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit ministry (EIN 45-5349618) that also builds FreeShow and Lessons.church under the ChurchApps name.

faq.q: Will B1 start charging later?
faq.a: B1 is funded by donations and grants, not subscriptions, and the code is open source. If you ever want to leave, you can export everything.

faq.q: How do we get help?
faq.a: Visit the help center at support.churchapps.org or email support@churchapps.org.
